name: Comparables Table
name_zh: 可比公司 / 先例交易表
summary: Pitchbook trading-comps or precedent-transactions table with grouped headers, sector sections, mean / median / high / low rows and the target highlighted.
summary_zh: 投行标准的可比公司 / 先例交易表：多级表头、按行业分节、均值 / 中位数 / 最高 / 最低统计行、目标公司高亮。
description_zh: 估值章节的核心表格：每行一家公司（或一笔交易），列为市场数据、估值倍数和经营指标，可用 group 组成“EV / EBITDA → 2025E / 2026E”式多级表头。groupBy 按行业分节，统计行可放在每节之后和 / 或表尾（默认剔除目标公司），超出合理区间的倍数显示为 n.m. 并不计入统计；列可加热力底色、正负着色或用 RK 公式派生（如股价 / 52 周高点）。点击表头在分节内排序，点击行交叉筛选其他图表；适合 8–30 行的同业对标、先例交易和经营对标。
best_for: Trading comparables (EV / EBITDA, P / E, growth, margins) by peer group
Precedent transactions with LTM multiples and premiums
avoid_when: More than ~40 rows (use data-grid with paging and filters)
Two-dimensional grids of one metric (use sensitivity-table or pivot-table)

label.desc: Row label (company / target); also the cross-filter field

highlight.desc: Boolean flag marking the target row(s)

note.desc: Per-row footnote marker shown after the label, e.g. '(1)'

columns.desc: [{field, expr?, title?, format?, group?, heat?: 'seq'|'div'|false, mid?, reverse?, nm?: [lo, hi], sign?, stats?: false, align?, width?, note?}] — field names or specs; null = every numeric field. Include the label field to position it; expr derives a column with an RK formula

groupBy.desc: Field that splits rows into sections with a header row (e.g. sector)

stats.desc: Statistic rows: mean | median | high | low

statsScope.desc: overall | group | both — where statistic rows appear (group / both need groupBy)

groupStats.desc: Statistics shown per section (defaults to stats)

statsExcludeTarget.desc: Leave the highlighted target out of all statistics

highlight.desc: Label value(s) to highlight in addition to the encode.highlight flag

pinTarget.desc: false | 'top' | 'bottom' — lift the target rows out of their section

labelTitle.desc: Header of the label column (defaults to the field title)

labelWidth.desc: Width of the label column (px or CSS length)

notes.desc: {"<label value>": "(1)"} footnote markers after row labels (the note text goes in the block footer)

sort.desc: {field, dir: 'asc'|'desc'} initial sort; rows always sort within their section

sortable.desc: Click headers to sort (numbers descending first; third click restores data order)

scroll.desc: true: fixed block height with sticky header, first column and overall-statistics footer; false: the block grows to fit the table

stagger.desc: Staggered row reveal on first paint

crossFilter.desc: Click a row to cross-filter other blocks on the label field

interactions: Click a header to sort within sections (FLIP row animation)
Click a row to cross-filter (others dim)
Sticky header, first column and statistics footer while scrolling
CSV export of the underlying rows
